fullDesc: On December 26, 2004 a magnitude 9.1 earthquake off Sumatra triggered a tsunami that killed about 230,000 people in 14 countries, from Indonesia to Africa. It led to a global tsunami warning system.
realFacts: Aceh in Indonesia was hit hardest
Waves were up to 30 metres high
There was no warning system in the Indian Ocean
Aid of billions flowed in from around the world
